acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

params._amount: The amount of ethereum to deposit.
params._minimumAmountOut: The minimum amount of yield tokens that are expected to be deposited to `recipient`.
params._recipient: The address which will receive the deposited yield tokens.
params._savvyPositionManager: The address of the savvy to deposit wrapped ethereum into.
params._yieldToken: The yield token to deposit the wrapped ethereum as.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

params._savvyPositionManager: The address of the savvy to refresh the allowance for.
The address of the savvy to set the allowance for.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params._amount: The amount of ethereum to deposit.
params._recipient: The address which will receive the deposited yield tokens.
params._savvyPositionManager: The address of the savvy to deposit wrapped ethereum into.

returns._0: The amount of tokens that were repaid.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner.

params._minimumAmountOut: The minimum amount of base tokens that are expected to be withdrawn to `recipient`.
params._recipient: The address which will receive the ethereum.
params._savvyPositionManager: The address of the savvy to withdraw wrapped ethereum from.
params._shares: The amount of shares to withdraw.
params._yieldToken: The address of the yield token to withdraw.

allowlist().notice: The address of the allowlist contract.

depositBaseToken(address,address,uint256.notice: Takes ethereum, converts it to wrapped ethereum, and then deposits it into an savvy. See [ISavvyActions.depositUnderlying](./savvy/ISavvyActions.md#depositBaseToken) for more details.

refreshAllowance(address).notice: Refreshes the wrapped ethereum ERC20 approval for an savvy contract.

removeAllowance(address).notice: Set zero allowance the wrapped ethereum ERC20 approval for an savvy contract.

savvyRedlist().notice: The address of the SavvyRedlist contract.

withdrawBaseToken(address,address,uint25.notice: Withdraws a wrapped ethereum based yield token from an savvy, converts it to ethereum, and then         transfers it to the recipient. A withdraw approval on the savvy is required for this call to succeed. See [ISavvyActions.withdrawUnderlying](./savvy/ISavvyActions.md#withdrawBaseToken) for more details.
